rationale: The bag was lost by Meridian Air on the June 3 arrival, inside the covered trip and within the 90-day filing window, so it falls under Baggage and Personal Effects in section 5 of the wording. Under section 5 a suit, a camera with its lens and a pair of shoes each count as one item against the $300 Premium per-item limit, so eligible items total $1,550, less the $350 Meridian paid and the $50 Premium deductible, giving $1,150 under the $1,500 maximum (section 10 and manual section 6). The payout is above $1,000, so it needs a claims handler's sign-off before payment (manual section 3).
